headline: Silks Place profits jump; Yi Gong to plant flag in Abu Dhabi in second half | Industry
summary: Silks Place International reported cumulative first-half earnings per share of NT$1.14, up nearly 50% year on year. The company expects its Hangzhou and Abu Dhabi restaurants to begin trial operations in the second half.
why: Silks Place is a Taiwan-listed hospitality and Chinese restaurant operator whose results reflect demand for its managed restaurant business.
